strategy.name: Balanced Auto-Invest Strategy
strategy.description: Monthly dollar-cost averaging strategy mixing blue-chip stalwarts, income ETFs, inflation hedges, and trending assets for a couple investing $500–$1000/month.
objectives: Diversification across sectors and asset classes

analysis.bull_case: AI monetization via Copilot across 400M+ Office seats adds $10–20B incremental revenue by FY2028; Azure share gains from enterprise AI workloads.
analysis.bear_case: Premium valuation (~32x forward P/E) leaves little margin of safety if AI monetization disappoints or antitrust action accelerates.
analysis.why_include: Proven 50-year growth story that has reinvented itself multiple times. AI is the next chapter. Foundation of any long-term portfolio.

analysis.bull_case: E-commerce + advertising revenue diversifying beyond low-margin grocery; Walmart+ subscriptions growing. Defensive in any recession.
analysis.bear_case: Valuation at ~33x forward P/E is elevated for a retailer; tariff/trade headwinds could compress margins.
analysis.why_include: Dividend King, recession-proof, holds value in downturns. Anchor for stability in any market condition.

analysis.strategy: Sells index call options on NASDAQ-100 to generate premium income distributed monthly
analysis.bull_case: High monthly income (13–16% yield) funds reinvestment or living expenses; tax-efficient option-premium treatment.
analysis.bear_case: Capped upside vs. pure QQQ in a raging bull market; distributions may include return of capital during sideways/down markets leading to NAV erosion.
analysis.why_include: Cash flow engine of the portfolio. Monthly distributions can be reinvested into other positions to accelerate compounding.
key_risks: NAV erosion in strong bull markets
Expense ratio higher than plain-vanilla ETFs
analysis.note: Reinvest distributions manually into MSFT or WMT for compounding effect.

analysis.bull_case: Record central bank demand, persistent inflation, and dollar diversification drives gold structurally higher. Safe haven in any crisis.
analysis.bear_case: Risk-off rally reversal if Fed pivots hawkish; gold pays no yield, opportunity cost rises with rates.
analysis.why_include: Gold has protected wealth for thousands of years. Portfolio insurance and inflation hedge. Non-correlated to equities.

analysis.bull_case: Post-halving supply shock, institutional ETF demand, and sovereign adoption create structural price appreciation over multi-year horizon.
analysis.bear_case: High volatility (50–80% drawdowns have occurred); regulatory crackdowns; competitor cryptos; speculative/no cash flows.
analysis.why_include: Small strategic allocation (12%) captures upside of the leading digital asset with limited portfolio downside exposure. IBIT is the most liquid, lowest-risk vehicle.
analysis.position_sizing_note: 12% max. Do NOT increase beyond 15% given high volatility. DCA monthly regardless of price.

analysis.bull_case: If DOJ investigation resolves favorably and Medicare Advantage reimbursements stabilize, UNH returns to historical premium valuation. Optum is a high-growth asset within the company.
analysis.bear_case: Regulatory/DOJ overhang, Congress scrutiny on prior authorization, Medicare Advantage reimbursement pressure, and sentiment damage from CEO incident.
analysis.why_include: Largest US health insurer with wide moat. Current headwinds create a value entry point. Healthcare is non-cyclical — people always need insurance.
key_risks: Political risk around health insurance industry
analysis.position_sizing_note: Reduced 10% allocation vs. peers reflects elevated near-term risk. DCA steadily — do NOT buy all at once. Monitor DOJ headlines.
analysis.review_trigger: Increase to 15% if DOJ investigation resolves or MA reimbursements stabilize.

analysis.bull_case: Dual demand (industrial + monetary) is uniquely strong. Solar installations require ~100oz silver per panel; clean energy buildout = structural demand. Gold/Silver ratio reversion historically adds 30–50% outperformance.
analysis.bear_case: More volatile than gold (2x typical); industrial demand drops in recession; smaller market = larger price swings.
analysis.why_include: Smaller position complements gold. Silver has more industrial exposure and higher upside potential if clean-energy demand accelerates.

auto_invest_schedule.method: Dollar-cost averaging (DCA) — buy regardless of price
broker_recommendations: Fidelity (fractional shares, no commissions, automatic investing)
M1 Finance (automated pie-based investing — ideal for this strategy)

drip_settings.QQQI: Disable DRIP — reinvest distributions manually into MSFT or WMT
drip_settings.UNH: Disable DRIP until DOJ overhang clears

rebalancing_rules.threshold: Rebalance any position that drifts more than +/- 5% from target weight
rebalancing_rules.frequency: Review quarterly; rebalance if threshold breached
rebalancing_rules.tax_note: Use new monthly contributions to rebalance (buy underweight positions) before selling to avoid taxable events
rebalancing_rules.annual_review: Full strategy review each January — reassess UNH regulatory risk, Bitcoin allocation, and macro environment

risk_management.max_single_position: 25% (MSFT — justified by wide moat, reduce if exceeds 30%)
risk_management.stop_loss_philosophy: No hard stop-losses for core DCA strategy — volatility is expected. Only exit if investment thesis breaks.

thesis_break_conditions.MSFT: Azure loses significant cloud market share OR AI monetization fails over 3 years
thesis_break_conditions.WMT: Sustained market share loss to Amazon/Target OR dividend cut
thesis_break_conditions.QQQI: Persistent NAV decline > 20% over 12 months with no recovery
thesis_break_conditions.IAU: Structural deflationary environment + rising real yields sustained > 24 months
thesis_break_conditions.IBIT: Bitcoin ETF regulatory ban OR Bitcoin loses 90%+ and fundamentals collapse
thesis_break_conditions.UNH: DOJ forces structural breakup OR Medicare Advantage business is banned
thesis_break_conditions.SLV: Structural substitution eliminates industrial silver demand

metrics_to_track: Monthly income received (QQQI distributions + MSFT/WMT dividends)

review_calendar.annually: Full rebalance review, tax-loss harvesting assessment, strategy reassessment
